note: Published scores in percent, for checking the L0 evaluation settings (requirements FR-QNT-04): a large gap means the settings differ, not that L0 is wrong. Qwen gives no prompt or shot settings for its instruction models. MMLU, CMMLU and C-Eval are not published for the instruction model; MMLU 47.5 (5-shot) is the base model Qwen2.5-0.5B.

scoresOfOtherSettings.humaneval: HumanEval (base tests); the benchmark here scores HumanEval+ (base and plus tests)
scoresOfOtherSettings.mbpp: MBPP (base tests); the benchmark here scores MBPP+ (base and plus tests)
